name: Mediator

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Mediation session (2 hours)
services.story: The main story: a 2-hour mediation session, $300. Alex pays a $100 deposit to book, and the other person says yes on their own link. The $200 rest is paid at the front desk after the session.

services.name: Half-day mediation (4 hours)
services.story: A half-day mediation (4 hours), $550, paid in full when booked. Nothing more to pay.

services.name: Intake meeting
services.story: An intake meeting by video, $75 for one person. Nothing is taken; Rosie texts the bill when Dana texts DONE.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Mediation at your location (2 hours)
services.story: The main story: a 2-hour mediation at a place the parties pick, $360 ($300 plus the $60 travel fee). Alex pays a $120 deposit to book; Rosie texts the $240 rest after.

services.name: Mediation at your location (2 hours)
services.story: The same mediation with a card saved for the $60 fee the business sets for a late cancel or a no-show. The $360 is charged when Noor texts DONE.

services.name: Half-day mediation at a workplace
services.story: A half-day mediation at a workplace, $660 ($600 plus the $60 travel fee), paid in full when booked. Nothing more to pay.

questions_before_times: What kind of dispute: family or divorce, a neighbor, a landlord and tenant, a workplace, a business, or something else. Only the kind, no details.
How many people will take part? Only the number.
In the office, by video, or at a place you pick?
Is there a court date the session must come before? The date only.
safety_stop: someone is hurting or threatening a person right now
license: Many places set no license for mediators. Where the state's rules require training or a roster listing for court-connected or family mediation, the mediator holds that certificate. A mediator who is also a lawyer holds their own bar license.
staff_skills: ["Family and divorce mediation","Workplace mediation","Neighbor and landlord-tenant disputes","Languages spoken"]
messages_never: ["what the dispute is about, beyond the kind picked","the other people's names","what anyone said in a session","why a conflict check didn't clear","any legal advice"]
